features.signature_rule: the k most stable features (mean stability over the STABL runs), k chosen by inner cross-validation

inner_cv.design: stratified 5-fold x 10 repeats (seed 2026); ComBat, prefilter and STABL (5 runs x 1,000 subsamples) refitted on each inner training part; elastic net tuned by Optuna (50 trials, grouped 5-fold CV x 2) on the top-k features, k = 3..10; highest pooled inner AUC, smallest k on ties

prefilter.rule: missing fraction <= 0.3; unstandardized variance > 0.01; for each Spearman |rho| > 0.80 pair the lower-variance member is removed (features are kept unmodified, never merged)

tuning_criterion_sensitivity.design: outer stratified 5-fold x 20 (seed 20261008), ComBat and tuning in the outer training folds
